completeness.why: shouldFillCategory decides the income/hidden/hidden-group/missing-group selection for every bulk action (copyPreviousMonth and setZero pass explicit includeHidden/requireGroup variations, averages go through getAverageFillCategories with the SQL hidden filter removed), and spendingToBudgetAmount takes the sign inversion in both set3MonthAvg and setNMonthAvg; the unawaited writes stay as site-local behaviour.

interface.why: Two named options carry the real variations (setZero writing hidden categories, averages skipping missing groups) and make the preserved inconsistencies explicit with no speculative options, though requireGroup only matters when includeHidden is false, so the pair admits a meaningless combination.

disguised_duplication.where: the three copies of the averages SQL and the two sign inversions are removed and replaced by shared functions, not reshaped
